family_coverage_rule.rule: Each Free Routine MUST include a skill from every family. All routine members must perform that skill in the same declaration on the coach card (not factored).
family_coverage_rule.exception_solo: Connections (C) family is excluded for Solo events.
family_coverage_rule.exception_free_combination: In Free Combination (Youth and 12U), one declaration from each family may be counted across solo, duet and team DD hybrids.

notes: Per-hybrid sum of factor weights for any one family must not exceed 5.0 (FAIL).
Per-hybrid sum of factor weights for any one technique must not exceed 3.0 (or 2.0 for Connections in Duet/Mixed Duet) (FAIL).
If raw count of codes for a family in a hybrid exceeds 5 (regardless of factoring), warn the user.
Factoring may only be used when athletes perform different codes/techniques.

no_repeat_acrobatic_definition.Group A: Cannot repeat same position(s) (as P1 or as P2), exception third position bonus.
no_repeat_acrobatic_definition.Group B: Cannot repeat same construction nor same connection (grip).
no_repeat_acrobatic_definition.Group P: Cannot repeat same construction, connection (grip), positions (P1 or P2, the third position itself may repeat) or bonus(es) — including the Pos3 bonus (Team Acro Catalogue 29.7.1.2 o).

theme_required_routines._source: World Aquatics CR Part Seven - Acrobatic Routine and Free Combination must be presented with a declared theme/title on the coach card.
theme_required_routines.rule: The coach card for an Acrobatic Routine or a Free Combination must state the routine theme. A missing theme is a FAIL.
